english: Scrap Storage Core
The heart of a StashNet storage network. Drive Bays and Terminals nearby connect to it. Crude, but it works.
Drive Bay
Holds up to 4 storage drives. Only accepts drives. Can be locked with a code.
Storage Terminal
Browse, search, deposit and withdraw everything stored on your network's drives.
Basic Drive
A crude storage drive. Holds up to 15 item types (1500 items). Its contents stay on the drive, even when removed. Only readable inside a StashNet network.
